messages:
sam_sales: FYI OptimaHealth just confirmed they want a 4-week POC to validate clinical notes summarization + question answering. Need to align success criteria, infra, and security ASAP.

nina_se: Thanks. Two quick Qs — what's the expected input size per request (full visit note, multi-visit thread?), and do they need live tool calls into EHR for meds/alerts?

sam_sales: They want entire visit bundles (history, notes, labs) up to ~45k tokens per case. Also yes — the UI should show live medication reconciliation via an internal API call for confirmations.

raj_ml: For 45k tokens we have two options: 1) host a 64k-capable base model (quantized) or 2) do retrieval-augmented pipeline: chunk + embeddings + reranker + short-generator. Tradeoffs: (1) simpler prompts & tool-calls but higher cost; (2) cheaper but needs optimized retriever and reranker latency.

linda_security: Heads-up — OptimaHealth requires HIPAA BAAs, SOC2 Type II, and customer-managed KMS for keys if we touch PHI. POC must run on Dedicated or Private. No hosted multitenant.

sam_sales: OK noted. Is Dedicated feasible for a 4-week POC? Cost estimate?

nina_se: We can spin a small Dedicated pool for the POC (2 x A100-equivalents) and enable burst for spikes. Rough committed estimate: ~$25k for the 4 weeks (includes reserved throughput + burst credits). If they prefer usage-based we can do short-term Dedicated with overage billing — will be higher unit costs.

raj_ml: On model selection: recommend trying two arms in parallel — (A) 64k model with KV cache + tool calling for EHR reads/writes, (B) retriever+embed (100k doc store cap) with a compact generator for final output. We'll track these metrics: 1) ROUGE-L on golden summaries, 2) QA exact-match on 200 curated clinical questions, 3) end-to-end P95 latency (goal < 800ms interactive), 4) CPU/GPU cost per 1k tokens.

sam_sales: Client priority order = accuracy > latency > cost. They accept up to 1s p95 but want p50 < 300ms for snappy UI.

nina_se: For embeddings/reranker setup: propose using 1536-d embeddings, Faiss IVF+PQ, and a neural reranker (cross-encoder) to push top-5 precision. Reranker target: +30% relative improvement in top-5 precision vs BM25.

raj_ml: Example eval harness snippet (we'll run nightly):
```
# simplified eval flow
for case in holdout:
  docs = vector_index.search(case, topk=200)
  reranked = reranker.score(docs)[:5]
  answer = generator.call(retrieved=reranked, prompt=template)
  score = metrics.qa_em(answer, case.gold)
```

linda_security: I'll need the security questionnaire responses by EOD Wed. Also require network diagram and encryption-at-rest details. I can do a templated ATO checklist for Dedicated.

sam_sales: I'll send questionnaire and add you to the customer call tomorrow. Nina — can you confirm needed infra config and a minimal observability dashboard (latency, token-usage, errors) by EOD today?

nina_se: On it. Dashboard: per-route p50/p95, token consumption, model fallback counts, and reranker latency. Will include example alerts: p95>1s, error rate >1%.

raj_ml: Need a prompt example for golden evals — here's a starting prompt for summaries: 
```
Summarize the patient's visit in <150 words focusing on diagnoses, meds changed, and next steps. Preserve clinical assertions; cite note sections.
Input: {{visits_bundle}}
```

sam_sales: Good. Client asked about tool-calling auth — they want scoped service account that only reads meds and writes reconciliation flags. Linda, confirm we can map that to their IAM?

linda_security: Yes, scoped SA with least privilege is fine. We'll require short-lived tokens and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.

sam_sales: Next steps checklist: 1) send security Q by EOD (sam) 2) infra plan and dashboard (nina) 3) eval harness + two model arms (raj) 4) cost estimate + contract delta for Dedicated POC (sam). Kickoff call scheduled tomorrow 11am PT.

ops_bot: Reminder: kickoff call added to OptimaHealth thread — 2026-03-21 11:00 PT. Attached: calendar invite.

sam_sales: Thanks team. I'll collate and send to OptimaHealth after the 11am call. :thumbsup:
